author: Cognito III
title: Ablation B: Broader Refinement (1024x60 -> 64x440)
abstract: This is Ablation Study B on the adaptive search algorithm. The hypothesis is that a broader, more diverse refinement stage is beneficial. The number of elite candidates for Stage 2 is doubled (from 32 to 64), and the refinement iterations for each are halved (from 880 to 440), keeping the total computational budget constant.
